summary: Assess blockchain, AI and IoT use cases, risks and pilot readiness in five days. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Blockchain and emerging technology assessment helps technology analysts, product owners and innovation leads judge whether proposals fit operational needs. The course covers mapping blockchain, AI and IoT use cases, checking data readiness and API or legacy-system dependencies, and evaluating security ownership, risk and potential value. Scenario exercises develop a pilot-priority scorecard and adoption brief; smart-contract coding, model development and production architecture are explored conceptually, not as hands-on build tasks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who evaluate, govern or sponsor blockchain, AI, IoT and related technology initiatives. It suits foundation-level learners who need to assess a proposal and communicate its readiness without a programming background.
modules: AI, IoT and Digital Twin Use Cases
NIST AI RMF for AI Governance
AI, IoT and DLT Data Readiness
Blockchain, AI and IoT Pilot Scoring
prerequisites: No prior blockchain or AI experience is required. Basic familiarity with workplace digital tools is useful; coding or programming is not required.
